quick_connect_desc: Connect with an address and credentials without saving a host. The address field accepts user@host:port.
quick_password_placeholder: Leave empty to be prompted on connect
quick_invalid_port: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
search_hosts: Find a host or ssh user@hostname…
empty_desc: Add your first server to start managing remotely
delete_desc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
ask_on_connect_hint: Prompt for password when connecting — password is not saved
agent_forwarding_desc: Allow the remote server to authenticate via your local SSH Agent, no need to store private keys on the server.
proxy_port_required: Please enter a valid proxy port (1-65535)
jump_host_desc: Connect through intermediate hosts (multi-hop supported; save those hosts first)
import_failed: Import failed, please check file format
keys_not_loaded: Keys are still loading, please try again
ssh_config_import_desc: Import {{count}} host(s) from ~/.ssh/config: {{names}}. Hosts whose name or address already exists will be skipped.
on_connect_desc: Sent to the terminal automatically after login; leave empty to skip.
certificate_hint: OpenSSH user certificate (*-cert.pub) matching the selected private key; stored encrypted with the host.
certificate_invalid: The selected file is not an SSH user certificate (missing -cert-v01@openssh.com marker)
keyboard_interactive_desc: Prompt for verification codes or other server questions; enables keyboard-interactive authentication.
auth_prompt_desc: {{host}} ({{username}}) requires additional verification to sign in.
test_connection_hint: Runs a real handshake with the current form values to verify the address, authentication, jump host and proxy. The host is not saved and no terminal is opened.
term_type_desc: Selects the remote terminfo entry. Use vt100 / ansi for legacy devices that do not understand xterm.
encoding_desc: For terminals using legacy Chinese/Japanese/Russian encodings. Input is transcoded before sending and output is decoded before display.
connect_timeout_desc: Total timeout for establishing the connection, including jump hosts and proxy handshakes. 0 uses the default 15s; max 120s.
keepalive_desc: Periodically probes the connection to detect half-open sockets. Shorten the interval on unstable networks.
